dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge (left) exhibits a deep concave spline curvature from the apex to the posterior basal insertion point, characterizing a highly falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge (right) presents a relatively linear anterior margin with a slope of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base chord length to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.8:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white punctate markings (speckles) and faint superficial scratches are visible across the lateral surface of the dorsal fin and the adjacent dorsal ridge.
